sdk/cliproxy/auth/auth_change_watch_test: Tests Manager.WatchAuthChanges per-auth change channels (Home/session snapshot invalidation), an API the TS manager does not have.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/codex_forcemap_ws_forw: Tests the force-mapping StreamRewriter on Codex websocket SSE lines; force-mapping response model rewriting is not ported (aliases resolve upstream, responses keep the upstream model).
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_cancellation: Tests Go mutation-lock waits under canceled or nil contexts (lockAuthMutation); the single-threaded TS manager has no mutation locks.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_credits_cand: Tests Antigravity credits fallback candidate selection (Antigravity provider and Home KV not ported).
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_execution_qu: Tests request-after-auth interceptors, LCP session hierarchies and quota response-header observation, none of which are ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_force_mappin: Tests force-mapping response model rewriting for OAuth/API-key aliases (and Kimi/xAI/Antigravity credits variants); the response rewriter is not ported, only the upstream model resolution is.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_issue6742_te: Tests the persistent Auth.RejectedAccessToken marker, Codex seven-day JWT invalidation lead and scheduler model shards; the port keeps only a pending-refresh mark (covered by the 6415 cases in conductor_issues.test.ts).
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_issue6819_te: Tests Codex SIWC (sign in with ChatGPT) dual-token refresh and rejection, which is not ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_issue6865_te: Tests oauth-request-scoped-errors rule actions (stop/continue/cooldown per status and match) combined with RejectedAccessToken; the request-scoped error rules config is not ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_issue7017_re: Tests Home aggregate retry-round scheduling and headers; the Home dispatcher is not ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_issue7056_te: Tests that wrapStreamResult does not read a reused gin.Context after return, a Go gin pooling mechanic.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_lifecycle_ra: Go race-detector test of published auth snapshots under concurrent goroutines.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_load_persist: Tests that a blocked store Save serializes Load and new registrations through Go mutexes; the TS manager persists fire-and-forget without mutation locks.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_oauth_alias_: Tests no-fork OAuth alias reconciliation of model states with the cooldown state store, registration epochs and scheduler tombstones, none of which are ported (alias resolution itself is ported in model_alias.test.ts).
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_oauth_reques: Tests the oauth-request-scoped-errors config rules, which are not ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_persist_fail: Asserts logrus WARN entries for failed persists (including Meta refresh); TS logs the same failure through log.warn but has no log capture hook to assert on.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_recent_reque: Tests the per-auth recent request ring and success/failure totals, which are not ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_request_scop: Tests the request-scoped-errors config rules (stop/continue/cooldown actions with regex matches) and Go execution-boundary error markers; the rules are not ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_result_polic: Tests the ResultPolicy hook that rewrites results before MarkResult, an SDK extension point not ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_saved_fields: Tests saved-field publication callbacks and Meta mint publication around store saves, which are not ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_scheduler_co: Tests rebuilds of the incremental authScheduler and its fast path; the TS selector recomputes availability on every pick.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_scheduler_ta: Tests targeted model-shard updates of the incremental authScheduler, which is not ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_speech_forma: Tests requestToFormat for xAI image/video/speech sources (xAI provider not ported).
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_usage_test.g: Tests contextWithRequestedModelAlias usage context values; the TS usage recorder reads the requested model and stream flag from ExecOptions instead of a Go context.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_warn_logging: Asserts logrus WARN output for upstream failures, Home boundaries and session affinity; TS has no log capture hook and neither Home nor session affinity.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/cooldown_state_test.go: Tests the file cooldown state store (.cds records, swap and restore); cooldowns persist with the auth record through the token store instead.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/cooldown_view_test.go: Tests CooldownSnapshotForAuth views used only by the Management API auth-files listing (not ported).
sdk/cliproxy/auth/custom_headers_test.go: Tests metadata custom headers with the $CPA-SESSION-ID placeholder bound by session affinity and request interceptors, which are not ported (static per-credential headers are applied by the executors).
sdk/cliproxy/auth/error_events_test.go: Tests error events published to the Redis error queue, which is not ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/file_snapshot_traffic_: Tests the on-disk auth file snapshot binding fenced against result saves, which is not ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/metadata_merge_test.go: Tests the three-way MergeRefreshedAuth/MergeExistingAuthMetadata of refresh results with concurrent proxy and metadata edits (and SIWC); the TS refresh replaces the record and only drops a result whose credentials changed concurrently (issue 6417).
sdk/cliproxy/auth/openai_compat_pool_tes: Tests OpenAI-compatibility model alias pools (several upstream models behind one alias rotated within a credential), which are not ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/quota_signals_test.go: Tests quota observation signals read from provider response headers into QuotaState, which are not ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/request_auth_prepare_t: Tests RequestAuthPreparer request-time credential preparation and Home ephemeral dispatch auths, neither of which is ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/request_termination_te: Tests that a terminated request skips the Antigravity credits fallback (Antigravity not ported).
sdk/cliproxy/auth/response_model_rewrite: Tests the force-mapping StreamRewriter/rewriteModelInResponse across provider SSE formats; force-mapping response rewriting is not ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/selected_auth_metadata: Tests publishing the stable auth Index through the selected-auth-index callback; the stable Index is not ported (only the selected auth id callback is).
sdk/cliproxy/auth/selector_guardian_affi: Tests guardian parent bindings of the session-affinity selector, an optional routing mode not ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/selector_lcp_test.go: Tests longest-common-prefix conversation fingerprints and subagent/fork inheritance of the session-affinity selector, an optional routing mode not ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/selector_subagent_affi: Tests subagent inheritance of the session-affinity selector, an optional routing mode not ported.
sdk/cliproxy/auth/trusted_retry_after_te: Tests the trustedRetryAfterError wrapper and Home aggregate deadlines; the port returns the original StatusError and derives Retry-After from its retryAfterMs (see issue7017.test.ts).
